d: US special envoy Jared Kushner has issued a blunt warning to Israel, saying the country risks becoming a “global pariah” if it continues on its current path. Kushner said Israel faces a critical choice between greater international integration and growing diplomatic isolation. His remarks come amid rising tensions between the Trump administration and Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu over the future of Gaza. Kushner has expressed frustration over Netanyahu's resistance to the US-backed Board of Peace plan for Gaza's reconstruction and transitional governance.
